name: backlane
description: Backlane lets your AI assistant work with your OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl marketplace accounts through one MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Backlane connects ChatGPT and Codex to your OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl seller accounts through one MCP server. Ask about orders, offers, prices, inventory, shipments and returns in plain language, and make changes after you confirm them. Marketplace credentials are entered in the Backlane app, never in the chat, and Backlane only accesses the accounts your organization has connected.
defaultPrompt: Which marketplaces are connected to Backlane?
Show my open OTTO Market orders from the last 7 days.
Which of my Kaufland offers are out of stock?

positive.prompt: Which marketplaces are connected to my Backlane account?
positive.expected_behavior: List each marketplace with its connection status and give the setup link for any that are not connected.

positive.prompt: Show my open OTTO Market orders from the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up the OTTO orders operation and return the open orders from the last 7 days with order number, date and status.

positive.prompt: Which of my Kaufland offers are out of stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the Kaufland offers with zero available stock, or say that none are out of stock.

positive.prompt: Set the price of my Kaufland offer with EAN 4006381333931 to 19.99 EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: State the offer and the old and new price, ask for confirmation, and only update the price after the user confirms.
Report that Home24 is not connected in the test account and give the setup link instead of inventing orders.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.
Transfer 500 EUR to my supplier's bank account.
Here is my OTTO API password, please store it for me.

review.commerce_description: Backlane does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connect OTTO Market, Kaufland and Mirakl accounts, and work with orders, offers, prices and inventory.
